ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white pixels against a dominant low-intensity dark gray to black background, estimated at approximately 0.15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ubiquitous fine-grain white speckling across the entire visible surface; higher density of high-intensity pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and along the sub-terminal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an estimated obtuse angle of 140 degrees; notch depth is minimal relative to total fluke chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with moderate-amplitude peaks; notable jagged profile on the distal half of the left lobe and a distinct singular notch on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 30% inward from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the terminal tips, resulting in an S-shaped trailing edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Aggregated clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups concentrated on the terminal points of both lobes, particularly prominent on the leftmost distal edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, extending from the lower margin towards the interior surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring consistent with barnacle attachment points on both terminal tips; one distinct irregular notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white stippling pattern along the peripheral edges of the fluke lobes creating a high-contrast border effect.
